observations.behavior: Adds an output named image-digest to the build job, exposing the digest of the built image.
observations.posthog_connection: This output is consumed by P1.F1.H2, which uses it to publish an ordered image alias. Without this output, P1.F1.H2 cannot complete its task.

observations.behavior: Adds a new ordered_image_alias job that publishes an ordered release tag and then publishes an ordered image alias to AWS ECR, using the digest from P1.F1.H1.
observations.code_quote: - name: Publish and read back ordered image alias
observations.posthog_connection: This workflow publishes an ordered image alias to AWS ECR, which could be used by PostHog's deployment system. The workflow checks the digest and reports any mismatches.
